summary: A control machine that moves another machine's parameter with a low-frequency wave (sine, triangle, square, saws, sample and hold) around a centre by a depth, free-running over a period in ticks or locked to the song's beat. It makes no sound of its own.
use_for: Move another machine's parameter with a low-frequency wave.
quirks: It makes no sound of its own: it writes values into one parameter of another machine, chosen in its own target dialog (no tool sets it).
The output is the target's minimum plus Center and a swing of Depth, both as percentages of the target's range, rounded to the target's steps.
Period is in pattern ticks (16 is a bar at 4 ticks per beat); with Sync set to a note length it follows the song's tempo instead.
Start off holds the target at Center; switching it on restarts the wave from phase 0.

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.how: Chooses the wave: sine, triangle, square, saw up, saw down or sample and hold.
parameters.sound: Smooth shapes move the target gently; square and sample and hold jump.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: LFO cycle length in ticks (free-running mode). 16 ticks = 1 bar at 4 TPB. Ignored when Sync is set. One cycle; Sync other than Free overrides it
parameters.how: Sets one cycle in ticks, from 2 to 16384, when Sync is Free; 16 ticks is one bar at 4 ticks per beat.
parameters.sound: Short periods wobble; long ones sweep over many bars.

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: Modulation amount, in % of target parameter range (peak-to-peak swing = Depth × range).
parameters.how: Sets the swing as a percentage of the target's range (peak to peak).
parameters.sound: Small depths add a touch of movement; large ones sweep the whole range.

parameters.name: Center
parameters.description: Center value, in % of target parameter range. LFO oscillates around this point.
parameters.how: Sets the middle of the swing as a percentage of the target's range.
parameters.sound: Moves the average setting around which the target swings.

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.description: Phase offset (0–127 maps to 0°–360°). 127 is 357.2° (the code divides by 128)
parameters.how: Offsets the start of the wave from 0 to about 357 degrees.
parameters.sound: Staggers the movement against another LFO.

parameters.name: Sync
parameters.description: Time base. Free uses Period; others lock one cycle to a musical division.
parameters.how: Locks one cycle to a note length from a whole note to a triplet eighth, or runs free on Period.
parameters.sound: Locked cycles stay in time with the song.

parameters.name: Bypass
parameters.description: Disable LFO output (target value frozen at last write)
parameters.how: Stops the LFO writing to its target and leaves it at its last value.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: Switch: 1 = LFO running (0→1 transition retriggers from phase 0). 0 = stopped, target held at Center.
parameters.how: Runs the LFO when on and restarts it from phase 0 on each switch from off to on; off holds the target at Center.
